gaps.explanation: Statement (trimmed p5, governmental funds statement, Total column): total disbursements 973,711 include Debt service 'Bond issue costs' 780. The Building Fund budget schedule (trimmed p19) prints 'Bond costs' (780) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), not among disbursements (Building Fund total disbursements 164,565); detail[] already has it as section other financing, 'Bond costs' -780. Gap 973,711 - 972,931 = 780 = this one classification difference (expenditure on the statement, other financing use on the schedule). Nothing missing.

Statement (trimmed p8, Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds): Charges for services 167,824; 'Other income' 46,082 (Water 9,192 + Sewer 36,890) is printed under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (JSON business_type.other_financing 46,082). The Water Fund (p22) and Sewer Fund (p23) budget schedules print those 'Other' amounts among receipts: Water 115,672 + Sewer 98,234 = 213,906 = 167,824 + 46,082. Gap 167,824 - 213,906 = -46,082 = Other income, a receipt on the schedules and an other financing source on the statement. Nothing missing or duplicated.
